meta.title: ConvertCCY Pair Profiles
meta.description: Professional ordered-pair profile dataset for ConvertCCY pair pages. Includes category, content tier, drivers, summary, and FAQ seeds for direct generator use.

content_tiers.tier_1: Highest-priority pair pages, usually major/major benchmark pairs.
content_tiers.tier_2: High-value practical or macro-sensitive pairs such as remittance and safe-haven links.
content_tiers.tier_3: Broad long-tail pair coverage with reliable fallback content.

pair_categories.remittance: Pairs commonly associated with transfers, migration, and practical money movement.
pair_categories.commodity_sensitive: Pairs shaped in part by commodity and trade-linked forces.
pair_categories.safe_haven_linked: Pairs where defensive market behavior can matter.
pair_categories.regional_cross: Pairs mainly useful for regional comparison and pricing.
pair_categories.global_cross: General cross-border reference pairs outside the higher-priority groups.
